items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: You're trying to steal my drummer.

ctx.x: Coach Happy. The Red Happy. I can't picture that trombone player.

I can see the cooperators, cooperators, all, and economy all. I can see ourselves sitting there playing, but now who's that trombone? I can't remember. Another one, Morris Frankel, he was playing with René at the time. When I was playing with Buddy Petit, how come to play with Sam Morgan, Buddy Petit had Manny Gabriel.
He had me playing with Sam.

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Oh, yeah. I worked with Buddy Petitia about two years.

ctx.x: He was at Pete Lowndes at one time, you know.

Yeah, he was at Pete Lowndes at one time, you know. Yeah, he was at Pete Lowndes. Yeah, he was at Pete Lowndes, too. Did you ever work with Buddy Petitia? Oh, yeah. I worked with Buddy Petitia about two years. When was that? That must have been around, no, it couldn't have been two years. I worked with Buddy Petitia. In 21, when I came back from Los Angeles in 1921. Must have been about eight months, then I joined Sam Morgan's band, you see. Of course, I worked with Sam from 21 to 25, you see. Who was in Buddy's…
I don't remember. I've been writing just now.

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: Buddy Malady, you see, was playing with Buddy. When I was playing with Buddy, the guy was playing with Sam.

ctx.x: Well, at that time, you say you'd have your ensemble first. About how many choruses ensemble?

Oh, they'd play about three. About three on the choruses. Yeah, all together. Yeah, you see they play all. Now my idea, when they first started to play them solos, when they got the banjos? Yeah, the banjos. Yeah, you see. That guy was playing with us, Buddy Malady, you see, was playing with Buddy. When I was playing with Buddy, the guy was playing with Sam. Caffrey was playing on the roof guard. Now he was a fine solo man, little Caffrey. Fine. He couldn't read it, but I wish he had to get the banjo he would play.
And that was after you came back.
